# TIMECT

> TIMECT designs and manufactures precision horological wristwatches for collectors and everyday wearers, celebrating over 145 years of Japanese craftsmanship, precision mechanical movements, dual sapphire crystals, and enduring design.

## Overview
TIMECT is an independent luxury watchmaker offering sports chronographs, diver timepieces, dress watches, and commemorative editions. Every watch is backed by a 5-year international guarantee, individual caliber inspection, and dedicated concierge customer support.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://timect.com/): Brand showcase, featured timepieces, craftsmanship statement, and collection highlights.
- [Watches Catalog](https://timect.com/watches): Complete catalog of TIMECT watches with filters for movement type, case size, dial color, material, gender, and price range.
- [Corporate Gifting](https://timect.com/corporate-gifting): Dedicated corporate gifting solutions, employee recognition milestones, client gifts, bespoke engraving, and volume arrangements.
- [Journal & Horology Articles](https://timect.com/blog): In-depth articles covering watchmaking techniques, mechanical vs quartz calibers, maintenance guides, and horological heritage.
- [About TIMECT](https://timect.com/about): The history, philosophy, and artisan watchmakers behind TIMECT's 145-year legacy.
- [Contact Concierge](https://timect.com/contact): Customer care, service inquiries, warranty registration, and support hours.
- [FAQs](https://timect.com/faqs): Answers to frequent questions about shipping, warranty, water resistance, movement servicing, and returns.

## Key Watch Collections
- **Anniversary Edition**: Hand-textured silk dial artistry, 70-hour automatic 6R35 mechanical caliber, dual curved sapphire crystal, celebrating 145 years of Japanese horology.
- **HydroConquest**: Professional dive chronometer with 300m water resistance, ceramic unidirectional rotating bezel, luminescent Super-LumiNova indices, and durable steel construction.
- **Classic Dress**: Slim profile mechanical and high-precision quartz dress watches with genuine leather straps and sunburst dials.
- **Heritage**: Vintage-inspired timepieces honoring archival designs with modern anti-magnetic movements and exhibition casebacks.
- **Master Sports**: Multi-function chronographs with tachymeter scales, 316L stainless steel bracelets, and scratch-resistant sapphire crystal.

## Technical Specifications & Standards
- **Movements**: Automatic Mechanical (6R35 caliber with 70h power reserve), High-Precision Quartz (±15s/month), Chronograph complications.
- **Crystals**: Anti-reflective scratch-resistant dual sapphire crystals.
- **Case Materials**: Surgical-grade 316L Stainless Steel, Rose Gold PVD, Two-Tone finishes.
- **Water Resistance**: 50m (Dress), 100m (Everyday/Sports), 300m (HydroConquest Diver).
- **Warranty**: 5-year international manufacturer guarantee.
